capabilities: extract text content from X posts
save posts as new notes or into a specific directory
configure default save location and note format
save posts via commands and the command palette
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture the text content of X (Twitter) posts into vault notes, so users must copy and format it manually.
summary: X post saver that extracts tweet text from X (Twitter) posts and saves it as new notes in a configurable vault directory.
